articles.title: Browns coach takes blame for failed 2-point try
articles.summary: Browns coach Kevin Stefanski accepted blame for a failed 2-point conversion attempt in his team's 31-29 loss to the Titans on Sunday that saw rookie quarterback Shedeur Sanders watching from the sideline on the decisive play.

articles.title: McVay rejoins Rams in time to see 45-17 victory
articles.summary: En route to their 10th win, the Los Angeles Rams scored 45 points Sunday against the Arizona Cardinals, their most in nearly three years, and they did it despite coach Sean McVay's absence in the team's Saturday preparations as he dealt with an illness.

articles.title: 9-4 Jaguars: Nobody respects us -- 'which is fine'
